_comment: The words of the previews: a part ad's look at the part (preview.part.*) and going to see a car from the ads
(preview.car.*). Each is said one way (the first line of its pool). preview.car.at_dealer {dealer} the dealer's
name; preview.car.at_curb {street} the street's name, {seller} who sells it as the ads say it; preview.car.short

lines.preview.part.no_picture: No picture of this one: you'll have to take the seller's word for it.
lines.preview.part.hint: Drag to turn it, wheel to look closer
lines.preview.car.no_3d: You can't see much from here: the details are on the card.
lines.preview.car.hint: Drag to walk round it, wheel to step closer
